units.source_text: 是年夏季作古的三个人，他们生前我都不曾相识，无法直接感受到悲痛。

en.t: I had never known the three people who died that summer while they were alive, so I could not feel grief directly.

units.source_text: 只有在墓地上烧香膜拜的时候，才排除杂念，静静地为死者祈祷冥福。

en.t: Only when I burned incense and bowed in worship at the cemetery did I put aside stray thoughts and quietly pray for the souls of the dead.

units.source_text: 我看见不少年轻人垂下双手，低头进香，但我却是双手合十，顶礼膜拜。

en.t: I saw many young people let their hands hang at their sides and bow their heads as they offered incense, but I pressed my palms together and bowed deeply in reverence.

units.source_text: 许多时候，我的心比起同死者感情淡薄的参加葬礼的人来，要虔诚得多。

en.t: Often, my heart was far more devout than that of funeral attendees whose feelings for the dead were shallow.

units.source_text: 因为葬礼的情形刺激了我，使我忆起亲切待我的故人在世之时、弥留之际，以及葬礼之日的情景。

en.t: The circumstances of the funeral stirred me, making me remember the scenes of those deceased people who had treated me kindly: their days alive, their final moments, and the day of their funeral.

units.source_text: 相反地，通过往事的回忆，我的心也变得平静了。

en.t: Conversely, through those memories of the past, my heart also grew calm.

units.source_text: 越是生前与我关系疏远的故人的葬礼，就越是牵起我这样的心情：

en.t: The more distant the deceased had been from me in life, the more their funeral stirred this feeling in me:

units.source_text: 带着自己的记忆，奔赴坟场，面对记忆，合十膜拜。

en.t: to carry my own memories, hurry to the graveyard, face those memories, and worship with my palms pressed together.

units.source_text: 少年时代，在见了也不认识的故人的葬礼上，我的表情也能同那种场面相称，而不用装模作样。

en.t: In my boyhood, even at the funeral of someone I would not have recognized if I saw them, my expression could suit the occasion without any need for pretense.

units.source_text: 因为存在于我身上的寂寞，得到了表现的机会。

en.t: That was because the loneliness within me had found a chance to show itself.
